assumptions.statement: Official three-level boundaries and key-area polygons are not available; this package uses provisional rough polygons from the site package.
assumptions.impact: All area metrics are provisional and must be recalculated when official geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setbacks) are missing from public materials.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity is presented only as conceptual ranges; FAR and height metrics are unknown.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines and cross-sections are missing.
assumptions.impact: Road network, slow mobility and transit connections are conceptual organizations, not engineering alignments.

assumptions.statement: Existing parcel boundaries, ownership and building baselines are missing.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish/new-build classification is conceptual only and parcel-level conclusions are avoided.

assumptions.statement: Official heritage protection control lines (Tsinghua Park station) are missing.
assumptions.impact: Heritage-adjacent design remains conservative; the concept heritage zone is clearly labeled provisional.

assumptions.statement: Municipal pipelines, public facility inventories and engineering feasibility conditions are missing.
assumptions.impact: Municipal and service strategies are system-level recommendations to be deepened by professional teams.
